rendered:
According to the review, between the starting points and 2020, LIB energy density rose from 150 to 250 Wh kg^-1. This represents a 66.7% increase in energy density.

The review also states that battery cost fell from over $1000 kWh^-1 in 2008 to around $130 kWh^-1 in 2020. This represents a decrease of 87% in battery cost.
